A PRACTICAL STARTING POINT

Build one useful tool.
Learn from a real workflow.

Replay inspection and experiment comparison have the closest connection to the existing code. A small product around those records could test usability before attempting a new scientific domain.

Trace the research dependencies ↗
  1. 01

    Define the first job

    Choose one user, one question, and an output they can inspect.

  2. 02

    Expose the assumptions

    Show provenance, model boundaries, and uncertainty alongside the result.

  3. 03

    Set a release gate

    Test the workflow against a known reference and representative users.

  4. 04

    Expand after evidence

    Add domains when their models and interfaces are supported by measurements.
